description: This is a source file defining the LogWrapper class in Java, which implements the LogNode interface. It wraps Android's native Log utility to enable logging with potential chaining of log nodes.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A helper class that wraps Android's native Log utility, implementing the LogNode interface to allow chaining of log processing nodes.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the linked list chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode to receive log data after this one.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats and outputs the log message using Android's native Log, and forwards the log to the next node if present.
